name: switchboard-citations
description: Sends the current editor selection into a Switchboard chat's draft as an attributed citation. Talks to the hub's local console API directly.

commands.title: Switchboard: Send Selection to Chat Draft

switchboard.hubUrl.description: The hub's private console/API listener (loopback). Do not point this at the public tunnel.

switchboard.token.description: Bearer token for the private listener, matching MCP_SWITCHBOARD_PRIVATE_TOKEN on the hub. Leave empty when the hub has no token.
